phase: Synthetic model-timed premium selling in markets never examined: Nasdaq-100 (VXN) and EUR/USD (EVZ)
written_before_any_result: 2026-10-03. FRED series were downloaded and only dates and row counts checked; no return or signal computed.
data: FRED: NASDAQ100 (index close) with VXNCLS; DEXUSEU (USD per EUR noon rate) with EVZCLS; DTB3 for T-bills (excess returns are on collateral, so the option P&L is reported per unit notional without adding rf)
synthetic_option: Every 21 sessions of each underlying (from its first date with an implied index and a HAR forecast), sell a 21-session option struck at the close: price = Black-Scholes (r = 0) with vol = k x index / 100 and T = 21/252; k = 0.88 for VXN (equity indices trade ATM below the variance-swap level) and 0.97 for EVZ; payoff from the close 21 sessions later. This is not an executable price; it is an assumption, and k is the main risk.
instruments: short ATM straddle; short ATM put
returns: (premium - payoff) / spot per period, minus a cost of 3% of premium
model: sigma_hat = HAR forecast on the underlying's own daily log returns, exactly as research8/putwrite.py (walk-forward, refit each 1 January)
rules: market {NDX, EURUSD} x instrument {straddle, put} x {always, ratio >= 1.2, ratio >= 1.5}, ratio = index/100 / sigma_hat = 12 rules; plus the equal-weight two-market portfolio of each frozen rule
statistics: per-period series (inactive = 0); Sharpe = mean / sd x sqrt(12); moving-block bootstrap (block 6) for the interval and t
samples: dev: periods starting before 2015-01-01; test: periods starting 2015-01-01 or later (EVZ ends 2025-03-11)
freeze_rule: Per market and instrument, freeze the timed rule (1.2 or 1.5) with the higher dev Sharpe if its dev block t >= 2.0 and its Sharpe exceeds 'always'; otherwise freeze nothing for that cell.
test_gates: Strong per frozen rule: lower bound > 0, Sharpe >= 1.0, block t >= 2.0, Sharpe above 'always', max drawdown no larger than 'always'. The two-market portfolio of frozen rules is judged on the same gates.
sensitivity: k +/- 0.05 reported for description only (never for selection).
